shared_elements: low/high relief carving on pale beige stone-like surface
figures arranged in a horizontal row or frieze
repeated similar figures side by side
weathered, eroded surface with chipped edges
justification: Both show a horizontal band of repeated profile figures, including quadrupeds, carved in relief on a pale, weathered stone-coloured surface, which gives a loose compositional echo. But A is a tall, multi-register slab with very shallow, flat, linear reliefs (arched forms, net pattern, birds), whereas B is a single curving frieze of bulging, rounded, almost sculptural bodies with raised arms, so the manner of rendering and overall format differ sharply.
